title: animos browser editor: 25 motion templates export MP4 or WebM
summary: animos.app/editor is a React/Vite SPA with 25 ready-made motion templates for design showcases. Drop in images or video, tweak in browser, and export MP4 or WebM locally without After Effects or custom code.
question_it_answers: How can I export a short design-showcase motion clip in the browser without After Effects?
